title: An exact Pareto-financing frontier with heterogeneous expenditure shares
checked_scope: Competitive electrification equilibrium and equivalent variation; extension to household-specific Cobb–Douglas shares and endogenous nonnegative tax allocation
significance: Characterizes exactly when the project can be financed without any household losing, and constructs positive aggregate equivalent variation with no feasible Pareto-improving financing rule.
